tamsin.wardrobe: ivory inspection coat, cyan seams, transparent visor

soren.wardrobe: rust-red utility jacket, graphite work suit, red survey thread

locations.terminal: Mirrorline Central transit terminal, pristine augmented layer over exposed steel infrastructure
locations.platform: Mirrorline Central east platform beneath the high dawn window

props.red_thread: vivid red survey thread used to mark cracks and connect the characters

scenes.prompt: Tamsin inspects a flawless augmented transit terminal and notices one red thread at a cracked pillar.
Soren sings beside the cracked pillar while tying vivid red survey thread around the exposed cable bundle.
Tamsin follows Soren through the terminal, keeping distance as the red thread trails between them.
Soren sings on the east platform while Tamsin blocks his hand from pulling the red thread farther.
Soren performs into the dawn-lit platform as the augmented walls flicker away to reveal steel, dust, and cables.
Tamsin removes her visor, studies the physical station, and reaches deliberately for the red thread.
Tamsin and Soren pull the red thread together along a cracked platform seam while Soren sings.
The red thread draws a path through the terminal as the last augmented surfaces collapse into the real station.
Soren sings beside the exposed east window, red thread glowing against the warm dawn and weathered steel.
Tamsin and Soren stand side by side before the unfiltered station, holding the completed red-thread line.
